ungated_teaser.title: CARES Healthy Food Access Digital Platform
ungated_teaser.challenge_summary: The **Community Action for Economic Stimulus (CARES)** program sought to create a **digital ecosystem** to connect residents with healthy food options. The challenge was to design a platform that was **accessible, user-friendly, and culturally relevant** to a diverse, multilingual community, while also integrating various food resources like **community gardens, farmers' markets, and local vendors**.

key_outcome_analysis.headline: Strategic Outcomes: A Triple-Win for Community, Economy, and Health

metric_details.description: Increase in community engagement with local food sources within the first six months.
Reduction in reported food access barriers among pilot user groups.
Higher user retention on the platform compared to initial engagement projections.

fukuro_process.name: AI-Enhanced Persona Extraction
fukuro_process.details: Utilized **Natural Language Processing (NLP)** on community feedback sessions and survey data to automatically extract and synthesize **four core user personas**. This AI-driven approach ensured our personas were grounded in real user language and sentiment, capturing nuanced needs that manual analysis might miss.

fukuro_process.name: Predictive Journey Mapping
fukuro_process.details: Mapped out the end-to-end user journey for each persona, using a **predictive model** to identify potential friction points and opportunities for engagement. The AI highlighted areas where users were most likely to drop off, allowing us to proactively design interventions.

fukuro_process.name: Generative Design & Prototyping
fukuro_process.details: Employed **generative AI** to create a variety of low-fidelity wireframes based on the identified user goals and pain points. This accelerated the design process, allowing the team to rapidly iterate on multiple solutions before committing to a final high-fidelity prototype that was both accessible and effective.

extracted_personas.name: Elena, The Community Health Advocate
extracted_personas.goals: To easily find and share reliable information about healthy food resources with her clients, many of whom are non-native English speakers.
extracted_personas.pain_point: Spends too much time vetting resources and struggles with language barriers when communicating with clients.
extracted_personas.journey_summary: Elena's journey focuses on efficiency and multilingual support, needing a platform that aggregates verified information and offers translation features.

extracted_personas.name: David, The Urban Gardener
extracted_personas.goals: To connect with other local gardeners, share surplus produce, and find nearby markets to sell his goods.
extracted_personas.pain_point: Feels disconnected from the local food community and lacks a simple way to manage his small-scale distribution.
extracted_personas.journey_summary: David needs features that foster community interaction, inventory management, and direct-to-consumer sales opportunities.

design_assets.style_guide_summary: The design system, inspired by the organic colors of nature and the vibrancy of community, prioritizes WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility. It features a clean, card-based layout, large, legible typography (Roboto), and a color palette of earth tones (brown, green) and action-oriented accents (red, orange) to guide users intuitively.

component_details.title: Finding Nearby Food Sources
component_details.text: The platform uses geolocation to help users discover gardens, markets, and vendors in their vicinity.

component_details.title: Personalized Dashboard
component_details.text: Users can track their engagement, join community challenges, and manage their food-related activities.
